notes.title: Patch Notes for May 31, 2024
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience while we worked to fix known issues with these titles.

Both games included in this package have been updated to the latest versions of their original releases, with various bugs and crashes having been addressed.

Additionally, one of our main goals was finding the best way to tackle the game's various forms of copy protection. As you play, the game will prompt you with various questions, such as identifying a type of vehicle or entering a password/countersign combo. The game's original copy protection has proven difficult to outright remove from the game without causing major issues. Our solution here is to include the original documentation to get past the copy protection as originally intended.

[b]The solutions to the copy protection prompts can now be found in the Atari Presents launcher by selecting Documents for each respective title.[/b]

We hope you continue to enjoy these classic titles!
